How to Sell on Vinted UK: Beginner's Guide (2026)

This guide is for people selling unwanted clothes, shoes or household items. It explains the process and does not promise that items will sell.

How selling on Vinted works

  • Create a listing with clear photos, an accurate title, category, brand, condition and price.
  • Choose the parcel size and shipping method carefully.
  • After a sale, follow the shipping instructions generated in Vinted for that order.
  • Pack the item securely and send it within the deadline shown in the app.
  • Payment is held during the transaction, then moves to your Vinted Balance once the order completes.

How to make a Vinted listing people can understand

  • Photograph the real item in good light, including front, back, label and any wear or damage.
  • Use a title that says what the item is.
  • In the description, give size, condition, relevant measurements and anything a buyer should know.

How should you price items?

  • Search Vinted for comparable items in similar condition before setting a price.
  • An asking price does not show what an item actually sells for.
  • Build in room for offers only if you are comfortable negotiating.

What happens when your item sells?

Shipping options change, so check current instructions rather than old posts or screenshots.

  • Open the sold-item conversation in Vinted.
  • Check the carrier, label or QR-code instructions and deadline for that order.
  • Use suitable packaging and make sure the parcel matches the selected size.
  • Use the instructed drop-off route so tracking updates correctly.
  • Keep the drop-off receipt or other proof until the transaction is complete.

How do you get paid?

  • Money is pending while the order completes, then goes to your available Vinted Balance.
  • You can withdraw available funds to your bank account or use them on Vinted.
  • Identity or other regulatory checks can sometimes be required.

Common beginner mistakes

  • Hiding flaws instead of photographing and describing them.
  • Choosing a parcel size without checking the packed item.
  • Following payment links or moving a transaction outside Vinted.
  • Using poor photos or a vague title.
  • Discarding proof of posting before the transaction is resolved.
  • Repeatedly deleting and re-uploading low-view listings.

Stay safe when selling

  • Keep communication and payment within Vinted.
  • Be wary of messages asking you to use external payment links or share sensitive information.

Do you pay tax on Vinted sales?

  • Selling your own unwanted possessions does not automatically make you a trader.
  • HMRC says buying or making goods to sell for profit is likely to be trading.
  • Platform reporting to HMRC does not by itself mean tax is due.

Quick first-listing checklist

  • Clean the item and check its condition
  • Photograph the item and its flaws
  • Write an accurate, searchable title
  • Add useful measurements and details
  • Compare similar listings before pricing
  • Choose the correct parcel size
  • Check current shipping instructions after a sale
  • Keep everything inside Vinted

General information only, not tax or legal advice. Features and shipping options can change.
